name: LANKO® 302 Cement Accelerator
summary: Lanko 302 Cement Accelerator is a calcium chloride hardener for cement mixes such as concrete, mortars and other sand/cement mixes. It is a clear liquid which will not alter the colour of the material to which it is added. Lanko 302 Cement Accelerator is perfect for use in cooler climates or during winter. It is also suitable when installations need to be finished quickly.

attributes: Speed up drying time in Davco cement based adhesives for a fast finish
usage: Lanko 302 Cement Accelerator can be used to accelerate the setting time of concrete, mortar and other sand/cement mixes.
Suitable for use when concreting in cold weather climates.
Lanko 302 Cement Accelerator can be used to speed drying times in Davco cement based adhesives.
Lanko 302 Cement Accelerator promotes high early strength and allows earlier finishing and removal of formwork and moulds.
By using Lanko 302 Cement Accelerator you can achieve 7 day compressive strengths in 48 hours.
advantages: Speed up drying time in Davco cement based adhesives for a fast finish
